verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a cloud data warehouse with a CLI, SDKs and Gemini assistant features, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry, usage-tracking or data-collection opt-out for BigQuery, the bq CLI, or Gemini in BigQuery. The compliance certifications and IAM roles in the pack are about other subjects and do not show an opt-out.
